    g = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find full-height/full-width divider lines.
    v = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]

    xb = [-1] + v + [w]
    yb = [-1] + hs + [h]
    xs = [(xb[i] + 1, xb[i+1]) for i in range(len(xb)-1)]
    ys = [(yb[i] + 1, yb[i+1]) for i in range(len(yb)-1)]
    # Odd panel counts leave the outer panel unpaired; even counts pair consecutively.
    n = len(xs)
    pairs = ([(i, i+1) for i in range(1, n-1, 2)] if n % 2 else
             [(i, i+1) for i in range(0, n, 2)])
    for y0, y1 in ys:
        for a, b in pairs:
            ax0, ax1 = xs[a]
            bx0, bx1 = xs[b]
            A = [[g[r][c] for c in range(ax0, ax1)] for r in range(y0, y1)]
            B = [[g[r][c] for c in range(bx0, bx1)] for r in range(y0, y1)]
            hasA = any(x != 0 for row in A for x in row)
            hasB = any(x != 0 for row in B for x in row)
            if hasA and not hasB and len(A[0]) == len(B[0]):

                for i in range(y1-y0):
                    for j in range(ax1-ax0):
                        g[y0+i][ax0+j] = B[i][bx1-bx0-1-j]
